def choose_move(observation):
    entities = observation.get('entities', [])
    position = observation.get('position', (0, 0))
    # Use defensive getters
    my_x, my_y = position

    def find_closest(targets, target_type=None):
        min_dist = float('inf')
        closest = None
        for e in targets:
            if target_type and e.get('type') != target_type:
                continue
            e_pos = e.get('position', (0, 0))
            ex, ey = e_pos
            dist = abs(ex - my_x) + abs(ey - my_y)
            if dist < min_dist:
                min_dist = dist
                closest = e
        return closest, min_dist

    # Identify relevant entities
    target_type = observation.get('target_type', None)
    relevant_entities = [e for e in entities if (target_type is None or e.get('type') == target_type)]

    # Prioritize moving towards closest relevant entity
    if relevant_entities:
        target, dist = find_closest(relevant_entities, target_type)
        if target:
            tx, ty = target.get('position', (0, 0))
            diff_x = tx - my_x
            diff_y = ty - my_y
            dx, dy = 0, 0
            # Prioritize axis with larger absolute difference
            if abs(diff_x) >= abs(diff_y):
                dx = 1 if diff_x > 0 else -1 if diff_x < 0 else 0
            if abs(diff_y) >= abs(diff_x):
                dy = 1 if diff_y > 0 else -1 if diff_y < 0 else 0
            # If adjacent, stay (dx, dy) will be (0,0)
            return [dx, dy]

    # No relevant entities, move towards (0,0)
    diff_x = -my_x

    if abs(diff_y) >= abs(diff_x):
        dy = 1 if diff_y > 0 else -1 if diff_y < 0 else 0
    return [dx, dy]
